in_marathi.name: Vibhu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God, Lord, Powerful
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vibhu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Vibhu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vibhu', which means 'God', 'Lord', or 'Powerful'. In Hindu mythology, Vibhu is an epithet for various deities, particularly Shiva and Vishnu.
